added.name: Saccade
added.long_description:
Alzheimer's testing today is bottlenecked around the onset of symptoms, when the damage is already done. Current treatments, including the FDA-approved drugs released in 2024, don't reverse the disease; they only slow it down. Earlier detection means earlier intervention.

Eye movement changes linked to Alzheimer's surface sooner than any other biomarker, up to 15 years before symptoms appear.

We deliver a 15-minute VR assessment delivered to patients in longevity clinics:
• Tasks: patients perform visual tasks designed by neurologists to trigger a distinct oculomotor response in people with Alzheimer's or on its path
• Hardware: our patent-pending attachment connects to any VR headset on the market and captures these eye movement patterns.
• Analysis: the patterns are compared against our ML model to produce a risk analysis.

Once classified, patients can access new interventions, such as the FDA-approved drugs. They're also referred to longevity practices, neurology practices or both, depending on their stage of decline.

Testing for the earliest biomarkers allows the earliest possible intervention. In some cases, that slows the disease enough that patients outlive the onset of symptoms and never face memory loss in their lifetime.
added.one_liner: World's Earliest Test for Alzheimer's Biomarkers

long_description.before: AI made execution faster. The bottleneck has shifted to deciding what to build while the knowledge behind those decisions is scattered across people, tools, and AI chats. Backdrop provides AI coworkers for projects and operations that understand your company, work with your team,and build shared company context. Across Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Asana, Google Workspace and more, they synthesize customer feedback, create plans and specs, manage tickets, draft documents, and keep work moving.
long_description.after:
Backdrop is a platform for building AI coworkers around the work you actually need done.

Start with an existing coworker or create your own for almost anything. Research a market, prepare client updates, run outreach, create campaigns, analyze customer feedback, build dashboards, monitor orders, coordinate projects, test products, handle recurring admin, or build a workflow completely specific to your business.

Connect the systems where the work already happens, including Slack, Gmail, Google Drive, HubSpot, Shopify, Jira, Asana, Linear, GitHub, Notion, and more. You control what each coworker can access, what it can do, and which actions need approval.

Backdrop works just as well when one person wants to hand off a job to AI. But it is also built for something today’s 1:1 AI doesn’t handle well: working together.

Employees, AI coworkers, clients, and partners can collaborate in shared conversations and workflows. One agent can bring in another. Work can move between people and agents without everyone starting a new chat and rebuilding the context from scratch.

Backdrop builds shared company memory from the work happening across your company. Decisions, conversations, feedback, documents, project history, and activity across connected tools can become context that people and AI coworkers can use later. A coworker can understand what happened before, another agent can build on what was already learned, and a teammate can understand why something was done without digging through old threads or systems.

The result is AI that works for an individual when that’s all you need, but can also become part of how the whole company works.

Backdrop can support businesses ranging from agencies and e-commerce companies to manufacturers, service businesses, SaaS teams, and more, because you build the coworkers around your work, not a fixed template.

one_liner.before: AI coworkers for running projects and operations
one_liner.after: Building your AI coworkers for any team, workflow, or industry.

long_description.before:
Conntour enables organizations to query thousands of security cameras using natural language.

Users can search past footage (“Find a man with tattoos on his left arm”), configure real-time alerts (“Notify me if someone climbs over the wall”), and extract data (“How many pickup trucks entered yesterday?”).

Unlike traditional video analytics limited to pre-defined parameters (like a weapon, bag, or license plate), Conntour supports unlimited, highly specific scenarios described in plain language. This enables a single human to monitor thousands of cameras.

Matan (CEO) worked with security cameras for years, leading video surveillance in the Israeli Military. Tomer (CTO) is a second-time founder and former director of engineering. Our team also includes computer vision experts from Israel’s elite 8200 intelligence unit and former top officials from the Mossad.

Conntour is backed by General Catalyst, selected for the first-ever Palantir fellowship, and advised by Bob Flores, former CTO at the CIA.
long_description.after:
Conntour enables organizations to query video - from security cameras, body cams, and drones.

Users can search past footage (“Find a man with tattoos on his left arm”), configure real-time alerts (“Notify me if someone climbs over the wall”), and extract data (“How many pickup trucks entered yesterday?”).

Unlike traditional video analytics solutions, which are limited to fixed parameters (like a weapon, bag, or car color), Conntour supports an unlimited range of highly specific scenarios described in plain language. This enables a single human to monitor thousands of cameras, or find a specific moment in minutes instead of days.

What makes the technology unique is its ability to process video at scale, fully on-prem, with minimal hardware requirements.

Conntour is backed by top-tier investors including General Catalyst and Y Combinator, selected for the first-ever Palantir Fellowship, and advised by Bob Flores - former CTO of the CIA.

one_liner.before: AI to monitor thousands of security cameras.
